decisions.reason: Confirmed nonfatal indexing defect: def-sequence indexes from zero, so 1/k and T/k were undefined at the first term. With k+1, both approaches lie in the prescribed faces for every k>=0 and tend to (0,0). The epsilon-delta continuity condition forces both corner values 1 and 0; the contradiction and Statement refuted are unchanged.

Confirmed fatal dependency-citation defect: def-heat-evolution-of-initial-data defines H_t only on L^p(R^n), so H_T f is not an interval Dirichlet terminal profile. For nonnegative nonzero interval data, zero extension and convolution with the positive Gaussian even give positive endpoint values. Replaced that ill-typed use by the range of actual forward interval solutions, whose own time history is a backward extension, and removed the wrong dependency. Explicit integer modes and finite linear combinations supply examples; Countable Choice and the C^{4,2} uniqueness class are now stated.

Confirmed nonfatal supplier-restatement defect: F1 called Q an open cylinder, but the supplied Definition includes t=T and the left time derivative there. The explicit smooth witness exp(t) sin(x) satisfies u_t-u_xx=2 exp(t) sin(x)>0 also at t=T; its parabolic-boundary maximum is 1 and closed-cylinder maximum is exp(T)>1. Corrected F1 to 0<t<=T with the left derivative and stated the C^{2,1} regularity hypothesis in F4. The counterexample and Statement refuted remain valid and unchanged.
